runs.text: What is gained by passing the operation as a value, instead of writing a walk for each operation?
Separating what repeats from what changes is the same idea as subprograms, one step further: now what changes is an operation.
The walk is written only once, and each new operation is a small function.

justification.text: What was repeated stays in one place; what changes is a value.
It takes the same steps; what changes is how much has to be written and checked.
The opposite: each operation is a function.
